dayNotePrefix: Walk or bike the 4 closed miles of FR 38 from the washout to the Elbow Lake trailhead first.
why: FS alert fs.usda.gov/r06/mbs/alerts/middle-fork-nooksack-fsr-38-road-closure (MP 7 washout, start 2026-07-27, no end date, last updated 2026-07-27, fetched 2026-10-29); WTA Elbow Lake page (fetched 2026-10-29) still reports washout/barrier at MP 7; PNT/WTA/row text give trailhead ~11 mi from Mosquito Lake Rd. Derivation: 11 (trailhead) - 7 (closure) = 4 mi one way on closed road. Stored day1 miles=12 (6 one-way) match the trailhead-to-summit figure (~5 mi to glacier + ridge) so the road is NOT included; the day note mentions the road but miles omit it. No sourced gain for the road, so walkGainFt omitted.

dayNotePrefix: Walk or bike the closed stretch of FR 38 from the washout up to the mile-12.5 switchback before the basin approach.
why: FS alert as above (fetched 2026-10-29). Primary variant drives FR 38 to the mile-12.5 switchback, which lies beyond the MP 7 closure. Derivation: 12.5 - 7 = 5.5 mi one way, both milepost figures from the row text/FS alert (same origin assumed; caveat). Stored day1 miles=7 start at the switchback so road not included. No sourced road gain.

New = 8 + 4*1.609 = 14.4 km, same one-way convention. No sourced gain for the road.
